description: Approved semantic micro-label catalogue for NewsLens 3.0

labels.name: elections & voting
labels.definition: Electoral processes, voting systems, voter turnout, campaign rallies, and election outcomes.
seed_examples: Voters turn out in record numbers for general election
Election Commission issues notification for upcoming state assembly polls
Exit polls project decisive majority for ruling coalition

labels.name: legislation & parliament
labels.definition: Legislative bills, parliamentary debates, constitutional amendments, and statutory acts.
seed_examples: Parliament passes crucial data protection bill after heated debate
Opposition stages walkout over proposed taxation amendment bill
Senate committee reviews new federal regulation framework

labels.name: judicial rulings & courts
labels.definition: Supreme Court and High Court verdicts, constitutional bench hearings, and landmark legal disputes.
seed_examples: Supreme Court upholds constitutional validity of government welfare scheme
High Court stays government order on land acquisition policy
Chief Justice constitutes special constitution bench for fundamental rights case

labels.name: public policy & governance
labels.definition: Government administrative policies, civil services, state welfare rollout, and public sector governance.
seed_examples: Government announces revamped universal basic pension scheme
Cabinet approves nationwide digital infrastructure roadmap
Administrative reforms aimed at speeding up citizen service delivery

labels.name: defense & national security
labels.definition: Armed forces, military procurement, border security, defense modernization, and strategic readiness.
seed_examples: Defense ministry clears procurement of advanced multi-role fighter jets
Armed forces conduct joint tri-service military exercise along northern borders
Navy commissions second indigenously built guided missile destroyer

labels.name: civil liberties & human rights
labels.definition: Freedom of speech, privacy rights, assembly, anti-discrimination laws, and human rights advocacy.
seed_examples: Human rights commission seeks report on custodial deaths
Activists march in national capital demanding strengthened free speech safeguards
New bill introduces strict penalties for privacy violations by state agencies

labels.name: cybersecurity & threats
labels.definition: Network vulnerabilities, malware, ransomware, data leaks, cyber warfare, and zero-day exploits.
seed_examples: Critical zero-day vulnerability discovered in enterprise firewall software
Hospital network hit by widespread ransomware extortion attack
State-sponsored cyber espionage group targets critical infrastructure grid

labels.name: artificial intelligence & machine learning
labels.definition: Generative models, deep learning breakthroughs, autonomous agents, neural architectures, and AI ethics.
seed_examples: Researchers introduce novel transformer architecture reducing training compute by 40%
New open-weight foundation model matches proprietary frontier benchmarks
Global summit drafts binding international treaty on generative AI safety

labels.name: semiconductors & chip design
labels.definition: Integrated circuits, semiconductor fabrication, lithography, foundry capacity, and silicon hardware.
seed_examples: Leading semiconductor giant announces breakthrough 2-nanometer gate-all-around fabrication node
Government subsidies spur construction of multi-billion dollar domestic chip packaging fab
Supply chain disruptions threaten global memory chip pricing and availability

labels.name: aerospace & space exploration
labels.definition: Space agencies, satellite launches, lunar/planetary missions, space telescopes, and commercial rocketry.
seed_examples: Space agency successfully lands robotic rover on lunar south pole region
Commercial rocket launch deploys constellation of low-Earth orbit broadband satellites
Space telescope discovers organic compounds in habitable zone exoplanet atmosphere

labels.name: consumer hardware & mobile tech
labels.definition: Smartphones, laptops, wearable devices, AR/VR headsets, and consumer electronics.
seed_examples: Tech giant unveils flagship smartphone lineup with titanium chassis and enhanced zoom cameras
Next-generation augmented reality glasses feature ultra-bright microLED displays
Foldable tablet market records 50% year-over-year shipment growth

labels.name: quantum computing
labels.definition: Qubit architectures, quantum error correction, quantum supremacy experiments, and post-quantum cryptography.
seed_examples: Physicists demonstrate fault-tolerant logical qubits with neutral atom processors
Post-quantum encryption standards adopted across global financial networks
Quantum computing consortium unveils roadmap toward million-qubit processor

labels.name: clean tech & renewable energy
labels.definition: Solar photovoltaics, wind energy, battery storage, green hydrogen, and carbon capture technology.
seed_examples: New perovskite-silicon tandem solar cell hits record 33% energy conversion efficiency
Solid-state battery breakthrough promises 800-mile electric vehicle range
Commercial direct air capture facility begins permanent underground carbon mineralization

labels.name: inflation & monetary policy
labels.definition: Central bank interest rates, consumer price index, inflation metrics, quantitative easing, and liquidity.
seed_examples: Central bank leaves benchmark repo rate unchanged amid easing retail food inflation
Consumer Price Index rises 3.2% year-on-year, exceeding economists expectations
Federal reserve signals potential rate cuts as labor market conditions moderate

labels.name: stock markets & equities
labels.definition: Equity indexes, trading volumes, market volatility, bull/bear cycles, and algorithmic trading.
seed_examples: Benchmark indices surge to record highs buoyed by tech rally and foreign inflows
Market volatility index spikes following unexpected geopolitical tensions
Small-cap stocks outperform blue-chip peers in heavy trading session

labels.name: startup funding & venture capital
labels.definition: Seed capital, venture capital rounds, unicorn valuations, angel investments, and incubators.
seed_examples: Enterprise AI software startup closes 150 million dollar Series B round at billion dollar valuation
Venture capital dealmaking rebounds as investors seek profitable business models
Fintech incubator graduates twenty climate-tech and payments startups

labels.name: cryptocurrency & digital assets
labels.definition: Bitcoin, Ethereum, decentralized finance, blockchain protocols, and crypto regulatory oversight.
seed_examples: Securities regulators approve spot crypto exchange-traded funds
Decentralized finance lending protocol surpasses five billion dollars in total value locked
Central bank digital currency pilot expands to wholesale interbank settlements

labels.name: corporate earnings & M&A
labels.definition: Quarterly financial results, corporate mergers, acquisitions, takeovers, and shareholder dividends.
seed_examples: Automotive conglomerate acquires battery manufacturing rival in 4 billion dollar cash deal
Quarterly net profit rises 22% on robust cloud services demand
Shareholders approve antitrust settlement enabling telecom merger to close

labels.name: global trade & supply chains
labels.definition: Import/export tariffs, shipping freight rates, port logistics, supply chain resilience, and customs.
seed_examples: Container freight rates surge as shipping vessels reroute around key maritime straits
Government slashes import duties on critical electronics manufacturing components
Bilateral free trade agreement projected to double agricultural exports over five years

labels.name: geopolitical conflicts & warfare
labels.definition: Armed conflicts, border skirmishes, military alliances, ceasefire negotiations, and combat operations.
seed_examples: Envoys convene in Geneva for emergency peace negotiations following cross-border shelling
Security council fails to adopt resolution calling for immediate humanitarian ceasefire
Allied military coalition conducts joint naval patrols through contested international straits

labels.name: diplomacy & bilateral summits
labels.definition: State visits, head-of-state summits, bilateral treaties, ambassadorial relations, and joint communiques.
seed_examples: Heads of state conclude historic bilateral summit with landmark civil nuclear energy agreement
Foreign ministers reaffirm strategic partnership during high-level ministerial dialogue
Special presidential envoy travels to regional capitals to de-escalate diplomatic standoff

labels.name: international sanctions & trade bans
labels.definition: Economic sanctions, asset freezes, export controls, SWIFT exclusions, and embargoes.
seed_examples: Coalition of nations imposes coordinated sanctions targeting state energy export revenues
Treasury department freezes offshore assets of individuals linked to illegal arms trafficking
New export controls restrict transfer of dual-use semiconductor equipment

labels.name: humanitarian aid & refugee crises
labels.definition: Displaced persons, asylum seekers, refugee camps, famine relief, and international humanitarian corridors.
seed_examples: UN refugee agency issues urgent appeal for 500 million dollars to aid drought-affected displaced families
Humanitarian aid convoy delivers essential medical supplies across contested territorial border
Neighboring countries establish emergency reception centers for fleeing civilians

labels.name: multilateral organizations
labels.definition: United Nations, World Bank, IMF, WTO, WHO, G20, and international regional blocs.
seed_examples: G20 leaders reach consensus on reforming multilateral development bank lending architectures
World Trade Organization dispute panel issues ruling on contested steel subsidies
International Monetary Fund approves 3 billion dollar structural adjustment facility

labels.name: higher education & universities
labels.definition: University admissions, college rankings, academic faculty, campus administration, and degrees.
seed_examples: Premier national university introduces interdisciplinary undergraduate curriculum
Global university rankings show Asian institutions climbing into top 50 positions
University governing board approves construction of state-of-the-art research complex

labels.name: curriculum reform & policy
labels.definition: National education policies, textbook revisions, STEM initiatives, and foundational literacy programs.
seed_examples: Ministry of education unveils standardized framework emphasizing vocational and coding skills
National education policy targets 100% foundational literacy in primary grades by 2028
Educators debate proposed revisions to high school history and science curricula

labels.name: student loans & tuition costs
labels.definition: Tuition fees, student debt relief, educational scholarships, and college affordability.
seed_examples: Government enacts comprehensive income-driven student loan repayment forgiveness plan
Public university system freezes in-state undergraduate tuition fees for fourth consecutive year
Philanthropic trust establishes 50-million-dollar need-based scholarship fund for STEM students

labels.name: edtech & digital learning
labels.definition: Online courses, remote learning platforms, educational software, and AI tutors in classrooms.
seed_examples: Schools pilot personalized generative AI tutoring assistant to help students master mathematics
Open-access digital university enrolls over one million students in vocational diploma courses
State government equips five thousand rural schools with interactive digital smartboards

labels.name: standardized testing & admissions
labels.definition: Entrance exams, SAT/ACT, national eligibility tests, test integrity, and competitive admissions.
seed_examples: National testing agency implements biometric verification to eliminate entrance exam malpractice
Ivy League universities reinstate standardized test requirement for undergraduate applicants
Scores on nationwide high school reading and math assessments rebound toward pre-pandemic levels

labels.name: public health & epidemiology
labels.definition: Disease surveillance, viral outbreaks, pandemic preparedness, air quality health impacts, and sanitation.
seed_examples: Health authorities step up surveillance after isolated clusters of novel respiratory virus detected
World Health Organization declares eradication milestone for waterborne infectious disease
Severe seasonal air pollution triggers surge in hospital outpatient respiratory visits

labels.name: pharmaceuticals & drug approvals
labels.definition: FDA/EMA regulatory drug approvals, clinical trials, generic manufacturing, and drug price negotiations.
seed_examples: Regulatory agency grants accelerated approval for novel targeted antibody-drug conjugate for cancer
Pharmaceutical firm completes Phase 3 clinical trial demonstrating 30% reduction in cardiovascular events
Government caps maximum retail prices for thirty essential chronic disease medications

labels.name: vaccines & immunology
labels.definition: Vaccine development, immunization campaigns, booster shots, antibody responses, and vaccine hesitancy.
seed_examples: Next-generation mRNA vaccine demonstrates broad protection against emerging seasonal influenza strains
Nationwide childhood immunization drive achieves 95% target coverage rate in rural districts
Immunologists identify key monoclonal antibodies neutralizing resistant bacterial infections

labels.name: mental health & neuroscience
labels.definition: Depression, anxiety, cognitive disorders, psychiatric therapeutics, and neurological research.
seed_examples: Clinical study demonstrates efficacy of novel neurostimulation therapy for treatment-resistant depression
National health service expands free telephone counselling and cognitive behavioral therapy hotlines
Neuroscientists map neural circuits governing memory consolidation during deep sleep

labels.name: medical technology & surgery
labels.definition: Robotic surgery, diagnostic imaging, medical implants, gene editing therapies, and prosthetics.
seed_examples: Surgeons perform groundbreaking minimally invasive heart valve replacement using autonomous robotic arm
Point-of-care rapid blood diagnostic test detects early-stage biomarkers in fifteen minutes
Gene-editing therapy successfully cures genetic blood disorder in clinical trial patients

labels.name: cricket
labels.definition: International test matches, ODIs, T20 leagues (IPL, BBL), World Cups, and cricket board administration.
seed_examples: Captain scores magnificent match-winning century in thrilling final-over World Cup chase
Cricket board announces revised player contracts and equal match fees for women cricketers
Franchise sets tournament record with mammoth 260-run total in high-scoring encounter

labels.name: football & soccer
labels.definition: FIFA competitions, Premier League, UEFA Champions League, player transfers, and domestic leagues.
seed_examples: Star striker completes record-shattering 120-million-euro transfer to European champions
Underdog club clinches domestic league title with dramatic stoppage-time header
FIFA awards joint hosting rights for upcoming international tournament across three continents

labels.name: motorsport & Formula 1
labels.definition: Formula 1 Grand Prix races, MotoGP, rally championships, constructor standings, and aerodynamic regulations.
seed_examples: World champion dominates wet-weather Grand Prix to take tenth consecutive pole-to-flag victory
F1 racing team introduces aggressive sidepod aerodynamic package for upcoming European circuit
Engine regulations announced for next season prioritizing 100% sustainable fuels and battery power

labels.name: olympics & track and field
labels.definition: Olympic games, track & field athletics, swimming, gymnastics, and international sports governance.
seed_examples: Sprinter breaks long-standing 200-meter world record at international diamond league meet
Olympic host city inaugurates state-of-the-art zero-carbon aquatic and gymnastics arenas
Javelin thrower secures historic gold medal with personal best 89.5-meter throw

labels.name: tennis
labels.definition: Grand Slam tournaments (Wimbledon, US Open, Roland Garros, Australian Open), ATP and WTA tours.
seed_examples: Top seed saves three match points to claim epic five-set Grand Slam singles crown
Rising teenager becomes youngest player in two decades to break into world top ten rankings
Tournament organizers unveil retractable roof and smart electronic line-calling system

labels.name: basketball
labels.definition: NBA, EuroLeague, FIBA World Cup, basketball playoffs, draft picks, and franchise trades.
seed_examples: All-star guard drops 52 points including ten three-pointers in playoff series clincher
Franchise secures number one overall pick in highly anticipated collegiate draft lottery
Basketball federation expands international championship tournament to 32 qualifying teams

labels.name: film & box office
labels.definition: Theatrical releases, box office earnings, film festivals (Cannes, Oscars), directing, and cinematography.
seed_examples: Sci-fi blockbuster surpasses one billion dollars in global box office ticket sales
Independent drama wins prestigious Palme d'Or at Cannes international film festival
Veteran director begins filming period epic featuring ensemble all-star cast

labels.name: music & streaming charts
labels.definition: Album releases, Billboard charts, world tours, Grammy awards, streaming milestones, and record labels.
seed_examples: Pop superstar's surprise new studio album shatters first-day audio streaming records worldwide
Global stadium tour generates unprecedented economic windfall for host metropolitan cities
Acoustic indie ballad tops international singles chart for eighth consecutive week

labels.name: television & streaming platforms
labels.definition: OTT platforms (Netflix, Prime, Disney+), TV series, Emmy awards, showrunners, and subscriber growth.
seed_examples: Hit fantasy television drama renewed for two seasons following record premiere viewership
Leading streaming network adds five million subscribers after rolling out ad-supported tier
Critically acclaimed comedy series sweeps major awards at annual Primetime Emmy ceremony

labels.name: gaming & esports
labels.definition: Video game releases, gaming consoles, game developers, esports tournaments, and interactive media.
seed_examples: Anticipated open-world role-playing title sells twenty million copies in launch weekend
Global esports championship finals attract sixty million concurrent online viewers
Major studio announces next-generation game engine powered by real-time neural rendering

labels.name: celebrity culture & awards
labels.definition: Red carpet events, celebrity profiles, fashion galas, lifetime achievement honours, and industry awards.
seed_examples: Stars dazzle on red carpet at annual museum costume institute benefit gala
Legendary actor receives lifetime achievement award from academy of motion pictures
Prominent celebrity couple announces high-profile philanthropic climate foundation
